next_steps: Run SOC-DFT (Quantum ESPRESSO) + Wannier90 for orthorhombic CuMnAs (Pnma, n||[001]) to obtain a realistic tight-binding Hamiltonian and recover absolute chi in (h/e) Ohm^-1 V^-1.
Refine k-mesh convergence around the SOC-gapped nodal line near X (adaptive/tetrahedron integration) since the OBD weight is sharply peaked there.
Add the chemical-potential scan (-0.1 to 0.1 eV) to reproduce Fig. 1(d) chi_zzyy(mu) shape, not just the single Fermi-level value.
Compute the angular dependence chi_zzyy(phi) under Neel-vector rotation to reproduce the 2-pi periodicity / sign reversal (Figs. 2d, 3c).
Cross-check the orbital-magnetization operator (modern theory) against the itinerant Eq.(3) L_z used here to quantify operator-choice sensitivity.

questions.question: What sets the absolute scale of chi_zzyy^(O) = -1.3 (h/e) Ohm^-1 V^-1 beyond the tau*D structure?
questions.why_it_matters: Our surrogate reproduces the ratio and scaling but only order-of-magnitude in model units; the physical magnitude drives whether the orbital torque is device-relevant (sigma_OH ~ 198 h/e Ohm^-1 cm^-1 estimate).
questions.next_step: Compute D_zzyy from a Wannier-interpolated CuMnAs Hamiltonian with the paper's tau=1.4 ps and 50 K smearing; compare number directly.

questions.question: How sensitive is the orbital/spin ratio to the definition of the orbital-current operator (itinerant Eq.(3) vs modern orbital-magnetization operator)?
questions.why_it_matters: Our ratio (~6e3) overshoots the paper's ~150; operator choice and boundary/gauge conventions can shift orbital magnitudes by orders of magnitude.
questions.next_step: Implement both operators on the same model and report the ratio spread; identify which the paper used and match conventions.

questions.question: Is the non-perturbative 1/gap enhancement quantitatively 1/Delta or a milder power near the nodal line?
questions.why_it_matters: The paper's central mechanistic claim is that weak SOC (gaps <20 meV) amplifies OBD; the exact scaling law determines how the effect behaves across weak-SOC material families.
questions.next_step: Scan lambda finely near zero on a converged mesh and fit |D^(O)| vs the measured local gap Delta to extract the exponent.

questions.question: Does the coarse 18^3 grid adequately capture the sharply-peaked Fermi-surface OBD, or is the ratio grid-limited?
questions.why_it_matters: OBD is a Fermi-surface (df/dk) quantity concentrated on the gapped nodal line; under-sampling can both under- and over-estimate D and inflate ratios.
questions.next_step: Repeat at 24^3, 32^3 and with adaptive refinement; report convergence of D^(O), D^(S) and their ratio.

questions.question: Does the real CuMnAs magnetic point group m'm'm' enforce exactly the tensor elements (chi_zzyy allowed, others forbidden) that our simplified 4-band model assumes?
questions.why_it_matters: The paper's symmetry table (Table I / S1) is what guarantees the CPOC selection rules; our surrogate imposes them by construction rather than deriving them from the real crystal symmetry.
questions.next_step: Apply the m'm'm' generators to the DFT Hamiltonian and verify the computed chi tensor has zeros exactly where symmetry requires.
